## Change

Describe the user-visible and scientific effect.

## Classification

- [ ] No output change
- [ ] Correctness bug fix
- [ ] Deliberate scientific-policy change
- [ ] Interface or packaging change

## Validation

- [ ] Added/updated a minimal synthetic fixture
- [ ] `ruff check src tests`
- [ ] `pytest -q`
- [ ] `storf validate` on changed GFF3 output
- [ ] Documented output-count differences and evidence interpretation
